comments.submittal_quote: Economizer operation is disabled during freeze protection stage 2 and stage 3.
comments.spec_quote: The economizer shall be disabled whenever freeze protection stage 2 or higher is active.
comments.reason: The submittal limits the economizer disable to stages 2 and 3 only, leaving out stage 4 and higher, which the specification requires to disable the economizer.

comments.submittal_quote: 3.4.1 Stage 1: when supply air temperature stays below 35 °F for 5 minutes, the controller sends two heating hot water plant requests, holds the outdoor air damper at minimum position and modulates the heating coil to maintain at least 42 °F; stage 1 ends after the supply air temperature is above 45 °F for 5 minutes.
comments.spec_quote: 3.4.1 If the supply air temperature drops below 40 °F for 5 minutes, the controller shall send two heating hot water plant requests, override the outdoor air damper to minimum position, and modulate the heating coil to keep the supply air temperature at or above 42 °F; this stage shall end when the supply air temperature is above 45 °F for 5 minutes.
comments.reason: The submittal sets the stage 1 trigger at 35 °F instead of the specified 40 °F.

comments.submittal_quote: 3.4.3 Stage 3: on a freeze-stat trip, or when supply air temperature is below 38 °F for 15 minutes or below 34 °F for 5 minutes, the supply and return fans stop, the outdoor air dampers close, the cooling coil valve closes, the chilled water pumps are energized and a Level 2 alarm reports a freeze protection shutdown.
comments.spec_quote: 3.4.3 Upon a signal from the freeze-stat, or if the supply air temperature drops below 38 °F for 15 minutes or below 34 °F for 5 minutes, the supply and return fans shall shut down, the outdoor air dampers shall close, the cooling coil valve shall open to 100 percent, the chilled water pumps shall be energized, and a Level 2 alarm shall be set indicating the unit is shut down by freeze protection.
comments.reason: The submittal closes the cooling coil valve during freeze protection shutdown, whereas the specification requires it to open to 100 percent.
